India Faces Widespread Monsoon Rains, Landslides, and Warnings

India is experiencing significant monsoon activity, with heavy rainfall causing disruptions across several states. In Jammu, landslides have blocked multiple routes, while Assam has reported over 20 deaths due to the rains. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued various alerts, including a 'yellow alert' for four districts in Uttarakhand and a 'red alert' for 16 districts in Gujarat due to heavy downpours. Several states, including Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Gujarat, have been warned of thunderstorms, heavy rain, and high winds, with some areas expecting intense showers and speeds up to 85 km/h.
